sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Ravindra Shukla,Satya Prakash Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. 
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh, J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Arpit Kumar, learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. This is the third bail application.

First bail application was rejected by this Court on merits vide order dated 26.05.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.14486 of 2022, whereas second bail application was rejected as withdrawn vide order darted 09.10.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.11996 of 2023.
3.

sentences.text: The present application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking bail in FIR/Case Crime No.0756 of 2022, under Sections 376, 323, 504 and 406 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Sultanpur.

4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant submits that statement of the prosecutrix, aged about 11 years, has been recorded by the trial court and in cross-examination, she deposed that there was dispute regarding money with her mother and the applicant.
He further submits that due to the aforesaid reason, the applicant has been falsely implicated.

He also submits that statement of the Ibney Ali vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43156067/
1 prosecutrix was not recorded at the time of rejection of the first and second bail applications.

entities.text: Ibney Ali vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Secy. Deptt. Of
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel submits that after looking to the statement of the prosecutrix, the applicant is entitled for bail.

5. Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for bail and has submitted that the prosecutrix was aged about 11 years at the time of incident and during her deposition before the court, she has stated that applicant used to touch her inappropriately.
He has further submitted that looking to the age of the prosecutrix and her statement before the court, the applicant is not entitled for bail.

6. Considering the above facts and circumstances of the case; the argument that the prosecutrix was aged about 11 years at the time of incident and there is deposition before the court that applicant used to touch her inappropriately after unclothing her, it is not a fit case to enlarge the applicant on bail.

. 
(Brij Raj Singh, J.) Order Date :- 12.9.2024 Rao/-
 
Ibney Ali vs State Of U.P. Thru.
